newsitem.title: FRANCE: No statement from Chirac-Kohl talks Saturday.
newsitem.headline: No statement from Chirac-Kohl talks Saturday.

text.p: No formal declaration is expected from a meeting between French President Jacques Chirac and his German counterpart Helmut Kohl on Saturday in the southwestern French town of Perigueux, a well-placed source said on Friday.
"It is a working meeting," he said. "There is no declaration, no statement planned."
The informal talks, first announced on November 7, are expected to last one and a half hours.

It will follow the presentation of a prize to Kohl's wife, Hannelore, for a cookbook she wrote that became a best-seller in Germany. Chirac and his wife are travelling to Perigueux especially for the event.

Chirac and Kohl will meet again on December 3 for another working session ahead of a full-blown Franco-German summit in Nuremberg on December 9 and a European Union summit in Dublin on December 13-14.
